title: fix(console): a settings page loads its namespace on the namespace alone, not on the translation function (objectui#13254)
body:
Part of #13254

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`SettingsView` loaded its namespace from a `useCallback` keyed on `[namespace, t]`. The effect that ran the load depended on that callback. i18next hands out a new `t` on a language switch and on every write to its store (`useObjectTranslation` subscribes to `added`). So each new `t` re-ran the fetch, and its success path reset the draft.

- The effect now keys on `namespace` alone (AGENTS.md #10).
- The fetch reads no `t`. A load failure stores the server's sentence when there is one, and the card translates `console.settingsView.loadError` at render.
- The draft still resets on a namespace change, a save and a discard.
- The save, discard and refusal paths and the leave guard are untouched.

## Why `Part of`, not a closing line

This PR alone does not deliver the card's Expected at the card's own public entry. In the console, a language switch also remounts the whole route subtree. `ConnectedShellInner` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx` renders `MetadataProvider key={language}` around every protected page. The remount is deliberate: it relabels the labels the server translates (objectstack#1319). It drops the draft on its own.

That remount is outside this card's claimed file surface and outside a page-local change. It goes to the seat as a decision in the report on objectui#13254 and is not changed here.

## Measured in Chromium 141

Setup: the console dev server on this branch, `/api/**` stubbed with the census F3 stubs, with `zh` added to the offered locales. On a dirty `/apps/crm/system/settings/localization` (Date format changed from `YYYY-MM-DD` to `DD/MM/YYYY`, bar "1 unsaved change"), the probe took avatar › Language › 中文. "Remount" means expandos planted on the sidebar and `header` nodes were gone afterwards.

| SettingsView | shell `key={language}` | Date format after | bar after | extra settings GETs | remount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| base `e70c21d43` | kept (as shipped) | `YYYY-MM-DD` | gone | 2 | yes |
| this branch | kept (as shipped) | `YYYY-MM-DD` | gone | 2 | yes |
| this branch | removed (probe only, restored) | `DD/MM/YYYY` | `1 项未保存的更改` | 0 | no |
| effect re-keyed on `t` (probe only, restored) | removed (probe only, restored) | `YYYY-MM-DD` | gone | 1 | no |

Each of the two causes drops the draft on its own, so both must be removed.

A second public entry reaches this PR's half with no language switch. In this probe, the app's own translations (`GET /api/v1/i18n/translations/en`) answered 12 s late, after the user had edited.
- With the effect re-keyed on `t`: the field went back to `YYYY-MM-DD`, the bar went, and a third `GET /api/settings/localization` followed.
- On this branch: `DD/MM/YYYY` and "1 unsaved change" were kept, and no further GET was sent.

The organization switch was also probed, with set-active held 3 s. In both states no settings GET followed set-active, so with these stubs it does not reach this half. The switch now asks first anyway (PR #13252) and then loads the document.

The probes lived in the session scratchpad and were never committed. Each probe mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which reported `git diff HEAD` empty after the restore.

## Tests

New: `apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.languageKeepsDraft-13254.test.tsx`, under a real `I18nProvider`:
- A language change re-labels the page, keeps the edit and the bar, and sends no second GET.
- A translation bundle written into the store (same language) keeps the edit and sends no GET. Both of these cases first assert that `t` changed identity.
- Controls:
  - A namespace change loads the new namespace, and the old draft does not come back.
  - Save after a language change sends the kept edit.
  - Discard goes back to the stored value without a GET.
- The load-failure card shows the server's sentence. Without one it shows the pack's fallback, which follows a language change without a refetch.

The test does not mount `ConnectedShell`, so the remount half is out of its reach; its header says so.

At `3885f682b` (this branch merged with `origin/main` `039e0b972`, which carries PR #13252):
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/`: Test Files 24 passed (24), Tests 189 passed (189).
- Ablation: `SettingsView.tsx` reverted to base `e70c21d43` (blob `966434655d67`), then restored to the HEAD blob `212616874e62` with `git diff HEAD` empty. Result: 6 failed, 1 passed (7).
  - Red: the two keep-the-draft cases (bar gone), the namespace control (3 GETs, expected 2), Save and Discard (bar gone before the click), and the fallback case (2 GETs, expected 1).
  - Green: the server-sentence case, which base already drew.

## Gates

All at `3885f682b`, each exit code captured before any pipe:
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^...`: exit 0 (34 tasks, run before the type-check).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0. `--listFiles` includes both changed files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint`: exit 0, with 0 errors. SettingsView.tsx went from 4 warnings to 3 (the `set-state-in-effect` warning is gone), and the new test has none.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`, `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0 each.

Changeset: `.changeset/13254-settings-locale-draft.md`, `@object-ui/console` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- The ruling's second sentence reads: "The namespace reloads only when the namespace changes, or when the user saves or discards." Save and Discard sent no GET before this change and send none now. This PR reads "reloads" in that sentence as "the draft resets", which matches the brief's "save and discard behave as today".
- The shell remount drops in-progress edits on every page under `ConnectedShell`, not only on settings pages. That is read from the source plus the measured remount of the sidebar and header. A record form losing its edits was not measured.
- The shell's language switch (`LocaleSwitcher`) does not go through `confirmUnsavedLeave`, the guard PR #13252 put on the other shell departures.
